name: Customer Address Change Notification for WooCommerce
author: berrypress

sections.description:
This plugin adds a “Customer address change” email to the WooCommerce > Settings > Emails tab that can be used to send admin notification emails when a customer changes their billing or shipping address.

1.0.2

  • Fix: Error when triggering email

1.0.1

  • Fix PHP fatal error due to loading Email class file more than once
  • Improve error handling

1.0.0

  • Initial release
sections.installation: This plugin can be installed under Plugins > Add New Plugin, either by searching for the plugin title or by downloading the plugin zip file and uploading it via the Upload Plugin feature.
